data.one_liner: An iOS 14 calendar and time picker style widget for Flutter with customizable themes.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Cupertino-style calendar and date/time picker widget inspired by iOS 14. It supports seasonal background effects, custom branding, and various formatting choices like 24-hour time.
use_when: You want an iOS 14 calendar or date/time picker style in your Flutter app.
You need customizable calendar colors, brand logos, or background effects.
avoid_when: You require a purely native platform date picker dialog instead of an embedded or styled widget.
You need complex event scheduling or multi-calendar management features.
strengths: iOS 14 Cupertino-inspired calendar and picker design.
Customizable themes, background effects, and brand icons.
Supports toggling 24-hour formats and minute intervals.
weaknesses: Limited documentation outside of basic property lists.
Not a standard platform-native date picker implementation.
